test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Amit told Shweta, "To reach our apartment, your mother must walk 560 m towards the east from her restaurant. She must then take a right turn and walk 543 m. She must take another right turn and walk 560 m. Then she must take one final right turn and walk 120 m". How far and in which direction is the apartment from the restaurant? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
According to the given information

Amit told Shweta,

1) To reach our apartment, your mother must walk 560 m towards the east from her restaurant.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c393eb801e6c4219a199a89e5a869d27a5dd69b81cecc434797d66d662d8d53.png] 

2) She must then take a right turn and walk 543 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ca84b37fac9c0cc90ecfeed9cb07666dd479554a32a4946a1f6775ac7de04d5.png] 

3) She must take another right turn and walk 560 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f81a41d2f08b76f1ff3101b66f1c8d2bf734fd07ffb8fb65e94a1a983ada9bce.png] 

4) Then she must take one final right turn and walk 120 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f41ede959441fd5ec15000bc2646e33a21cb0faf13c7db4b02282b099b13d1e3.png] 

5) The distance and the direction of the apartment from the restaurant is

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba6e587313888002cdfe9881e6a4c40464d3916c2aed4a758bc297bb82e5d7e5.png] 

From the above diagram, we can conclude that the apartment is 423 m far and is in the South direction of the restaurant.

Hence, the correct answer is **"423 m, South".**
